title: Enhanced hybrid deep neural network for EEG-based schizophrenia diagnosis using functional and temporal features.
summary: Methods process EEG recordings from 26 schizophrenia participants and 25 controls and compare the proposed hybrid network with baselines; Results report classification performance. Generalizability is limited by the small sample.
ai_technology: Hybrid EEG network distinguishes schizophrenia from measured patient recordings. The Methods specify the learned operation used for this case-specific result.
